estimation_sources.config:api_server_count: vllm/entrypoints/cli/serve.py:113-129@5df63a72 defaults api_server_count to the data-parallel size in internal load balancing, which is every stated value of the 131 InferenceX points; the engine runs its data-parallel group as one client (client_count 1, core/engine/dp.go), so the stated count changes nothing it simulates, and DPLBAsyncMPClient takes client_count as the number of API servers (vllm/v1/engine/core_client.py:1639-1640,1671,1685@5df63a72), which is why the field is not proven inert
estimation_sources.config:data_parallel_external_lb: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml has no entry; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, False (vllm/config/parallel.py:168@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.config:data_parallel_hybrid_lb: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml has no entry; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, False (vllm/config/parallel.py:175@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.config:data_parallel_size_local: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml:90 maps it to parallel.dp_local; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, 1 (vllm/config/parallel.py:149@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.config:engram_config.cpu_offload: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml:292 maps it to engine.engram_config.cpu_offload; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, True (vllm/config/engram.py:37@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.config:gpu_memory_utilization: vllm/config/cache.py:102@5df63a72 sets the default, 0.92; a run that does not record it leaves that default, which the engine resolves (resolveEngine)
estimation_sources.config:kv_offloading_backend: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml:130 marks it inert, read with kv_offloading_size; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, "native" (vllm/config/cache.py:272@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.config:speculative_config.model: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml:278 marks it inert, role drafter; a run that does not state it leaves vLLM's default, None (no separate drafter checkpoint), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.env:VLLM_USE_SIMPLE_KV_OFFLOAD: accuracy-dashboard orchestrator/vllm_arg_policy.yaml:348 marks it inert; a run that does not set it leaves vLLM's default, off (vllm/envs.py:2243@5df63a72), which the engine resolves
estimation_sources.env:VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND: vllm/distributed/device_communicators/flashinfer_all_reduce.py:143-178@5df63a72 resolves an unset (auto) backend to mnnvl on one node and on compute capability 10.0 and up across nodes, so a recipe that states mnnvl on a Blackwell part selects the kernel the default selects; the latency kernel prices every tensor-parallel all-reduce from the NCCL sweep whichever FlashInfer backend runs (it has no implementation-keyed all-reduce entry), so the stand-in changes no price. The field's valid_when says for which values and groups the stand-in is exact; fields/stand_in_vectors.json holds it to _resolve_fi_ar_backend
estimation_sources.env:UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED: vllm/distributed/nixl_utils.py:20-36@5df63a72 sets UCX_RCACHE_MAX_UNRELEASED to 1024 itself when the environment does not state it, so a run that states 1024 runs as an unset one does; UCX's variable (src/ucs/memory/rcache.c:114-118 at UCX v1.19.0, the version inside the nixl 1.5.0 wheel is not known) only sets when invalidated registration regions are cleaned up and does not choose a transport or a rate; the field's valid_when says for which values the stand-in is exact; fields/stand_in_vectors.json holds it to _maybe_set_ucx_rcache_limit
estimation_sources.env:UCX_TLS: NIXL's UCX backend is the default (vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/base_worker.py:525-526@5df63a72) and UCX_TLS restricts the transports it may use (UCX FAQ). The engine prices a handoff between nodes over the NIC at the cluster fabric's rate unless UCX_CUDA_IPC_ENABLE_MNNVL=y is stated (compat/kernelmodel, rackHandoff), which is the path a list of RDMA transports without cuda_ipc takes, so unset stands in exactly for such a list; the field's valid_when says for which lists the stand-in is exact
